nodes.description: IERC20 private _token: ERC20 token held by the timelock
address private _beneficiary: account that receives released tokens
uint256 private _releaseTime: timestamp after which release is allowed
TokenTimelock constructor: validates releaseTime against block.timestamp and stores token, beneficiary and releaseTime
token() view returns _token
beneficiary() view returns _beneficiary
releaseTime() view returns _releaseTime
release(): checks block.timestamp >= _releaseTime, reads token balance and transfers all tokens to beneficiary
CATXTimeLock constructor: forwards token, beneficiary and releaseTime to the TokenTimelock constructor
block.timestamp read in TokenTimelock constructor require(releaseTime > block.timestamp)
block.timestamp read in release() require(block.timestamp >= _releaseTime)
_token.safeTransfer(_beneficiary, amount): external token transfer performed in release(), which hands control to the token contract
_token.balanceOf(address(this)): external call to the token contract used to compute the released amount
IERC20 token parameter of TokenTimelock constructor
address beneficiary parameter of TokenTimelock constructor
uint256 releaseTime parameter of TokenTimelock constructor
address token parameter of CATXTimeLock constructor, cast to IERC20
address beneficiary parameter of CATXTimeLock constructor
uint256 releaseTime parameter of CATXTimeLock constructor
uint256 amount local variable in release(), set from the token balance of the contract

edges.reason: The constructor gate require(releaseTime > block.timestamp) depends on the miner-influenced block timestamp, a timestamp-dependent precondition for deployment
release() gates execution on require(block.timestamp >= _releaseTime), so the withdrawal can be triggered by miner-manipulable timestamp dependency
releaseTime parameter flows into the timestamp comparison inside the constructor
token constructor parameter is bound into the TokenTimelock constructor
TokenTimelock constructor assigns the token parameter to state variable _token
beneficiary constructor parameter is bound into the TokenTimelock constructor
TokenTimelock constructor assigns the beneficiary parameter to state variable _beneficiary
TokenTimelock constructor assigns the releaseTime parameter to state variable _releaseTime
CATXTimeLock constructor parameter token is forwarded as IERC20(token) to the base constructor
CATXTimeLock constructor parameter beneficiary is forwarded to the base constructor
CATXTimeLock constructor parameter releaseTime is forwarded to the base constructor
CATXTimeLock constructor invokes the TokenTimelock base constructor via the modifier-style call
token() returns state variable _token
beneficiary() returns state variable _beneficiary
releaseTime() returns state variable _releaseTime
release() reads _releaseTime to decide whether the timestamp condition is satisfied
_token is the target contract of the balanceOf external call
_token is the callee of safeTransfer, so the token contract controls execution during the transfer
_beneficiary is passed as the recipient of safeTransfer and is the reentrant token holder
The result of the external balanceOf call is stored in the local variable amount
Local amount is passed as the value of the external safeTransfer call
release() performs the external safeTransfer while the transfer is the last effect of the function
require(amount > 0) guards the transfer that follows the external balanceOf call
The external safeTransfer call transfers control to the token contract, which may re-enter release() before state changes settle
